scenarios.name: Detach an active drawing from the tab strip

scenario_steps.name: the drawing is active in the main document tab strip
the user drags the drawing tab from the strip into the workspace
the drawing is displayed in a separate window with its own document tab
the drawing sheet remains visible in that window
the part remains open in the main workspace
the user selects another open part tab in the main workspace
that part becomes active in the main workspace
the drawing remains open in its separate window
